authorization.source: User explicitly requested one month of autonomous COSHUMA operation, aggressive marketing, goals and revenue expectations reported first, then immediate execution.
authorization.scope: A bounded one-month campaign under existing business access, cost and content truth constraints; independent of the unapproved 2028 profit plan.
allowed: Evidence-backed edits and distribution of existing COSHUMA buyer content
Up to eight substantive buyer decision assets under this plan
Organic public posts on verified existing COSHUMA-owned accounts with authorized access and provider rules
Necessary reversible implementation, PR, merge, deployment and live verification
Reuse of the 13 existing enabled operating schedules
excluded: New paid services, subscriptions, ad spend or model upgrades
New accounts, tokens or secrets and authentication bypass
Repurposing personal accounts without business ownership and use authorization
Fabricated reviews, use experience, customer results or financial outcomes

period.comparison_rule: Requery matched 31-day source windows. Daily fallback excludes the final partial morning and includes the initial pre-start morning; disclose the boundary difference. Do not present the launch 30-day snapshot as a matched before window.

protected_experiments.rule: Do not reset windows, rename events or restructure these pages/CTAs. Only confirmed narrow bug or factual corrections, with deployment annotations. Attribute new campaign distribution separately and disclose possible contamination.

automation_verification_evidence.limits: Configuration verification only, not proof of future execution or notification receipt.

runtime.liveness_rule: Enabled is configuration only. Inspect actual execution timestamps and investigate lag exceeding twice the intended interval using the existing incident record and recovery procedure.

limitations: Unknown financial values remain null; unknown is not a confirmed zero.
GA pagePath views are not landing-page sessions; current output lacks page-by-source joins.
GA source row sessions sum to 367 versus 364 overall; the difference is unexplained. Users can overlap across source rows. Do not force reconciliation or calculate channel shares/conversion rates.
Historical QA exclusion is not fully established. Never label all aggregate users as new external buyers.
GSC page/query detail is 90-day; do not relabel it as 30-day.
GA, GSC, affiliate records and payouts have different clocks and delays; do not combine unmatched windows into a funnel.

targets.definition: GA sessions in the matched campaign window; report active users separately and disclose QA exclusion coverage.
Existing affiliate_click event definition, QA excluded where verified. Events are not unique referrals or customers.

New customer's actual paid purchase observed in supplier records; record purchase date and attribution. Separate signup/trial, pending commission, commission approval and payout. A paid purchase does not satisfy a 45/60-day commission waiting period by itself.
Source window and final available date must be shown.
Search clicks; not unique visitors or social clicks.
Newly recorded campaign commission only, by currency and pending/approved status. Do not substitute customer gross payments, lifetime commission, recurring MRR or payout.

financial_plan.interpretation: Zero cash is the planning assumption, not an assertion that current revenue is zero. Overall net profit cannot be computed without actual costs and a complete revenue ledger.

sensitivity_only.limitations: Illustrative conditional arithmetic, not calibrated probabilities, a forecast range or a ceiling. Fractional expected customers are mathematical quantities. Refunds, disqualification, tax, existing costs and payout delay are not modelled.

supplier_condition_notes.pictory: Current public signup describes 40% one-time first-payment commission; direct account correspondence is consistent. Current payout readiness and payment dates require account evidence.
supplier_condition_notes.gamma: 25% approval/public listing and later 30% correspondence conflict. Do not choose a confirmed account rate until the current offer is verified.
supplier_condition_notes.jotform: Base 30% for the first year. FAQ describes 60 days as a paid client before confirmation and twelve monthly instalments for annual plans.
supplier_condition_notes.highlevel: Standard eligible direct referral rate 40%; at least 45 days in good standing, monthly payment and possible hold until more than USD 50. A new purchase during this 31-day period cannot complete 45 days within the same period.

distribution.objective_condition: Verified ownership, authorized current account access and suitable platform rules.

channel_evidence.evidence: Current connector returned INVALID_ARGUMENT with 'This brand does not have any social network connected yet'; current official connection URL redirects to sign-in.

channel_evidence.note: Past secret-presence checks and private uploads succeeded. Do not claim no tokens exist or a later recovery without evidence.

distribution.access_next_action: Use an already authorized current COSHUMA owner session and supported provider sign-in/consent to restore one existing channel; verify its identity and a successful channel read before any publication. Do not create a replacement account or extract credentials.
distribution.blocked_execution_policy: At most one access-state check per day unless new evidence arrives; reuse the existing channel incident. Continue website assets, search distribution and previously authorized affiliate work. Missing public posts count as a missed distribution goal, never as completed drafts.
platform_priority: Existing verified COSHUMA LinkedIn, if available, for B2B decision posts
One other verified COSHUMA-owned text channel; existing YouTube only after access and footage rights/quality are verified
distribution.post_format: Each substantive buyer asset yields three distinct native posts: evaluation criterion, who should not buy, and practical checklist. Include a concise affiliate disclosure when promotional links are present, a supported factual claim, a useful standalone takeaway and a relevant destination.
distribution.pacing: Aim for six total native posts per week across at most two connected channels. Space posts normally; do not mass-publish a backlog after an access delay.
distribution.utm_rule: Website links use utm_source=<actual channel>, utm_medium=organic_social, utm_campaign=coshuma_20261004_month, utm_content=<asset-id>-<angle>-<date>. Keep exact supplier affiliate URLs unchanged.

prepared_posts.note: Approved core copy; campaign worksheet link/disclosure added by COSHUMA, not represented as vendor-approved additions.

calendar.actions: Launch Claap evaluation worksheet and improve the Omnisend–Privy buyer comparison using existing source evidence. Attempt legitimate restoration of one existing owned distribution channel. Establish the first source-matched campaign observation.
Improve Pictory workflow/plan-choice guidance and Jotform buyer criteria. Distribute distinct practical examples; check paid purchase and pending/approved commission records independently.
Produce two substantive supporting decision assets for topics with the best verified response. Use existing pages when intent overlaps. Treat small samples as directional.
Complete two further useful assets and distribute the best-supported angles. Preserve the October 30 fixed-window reading. Collect actual campaign outcomes and costs for closeout.

content_backlog.scope: One buyer evaluation asset across two related existing pages, with five-field blank CSV. Objection, transcript evidence, next action, owner/deadline and CRM field. The worksheet and two page placements count as one asset.
content_backlog.basis: Direct partner topic/publishing approval, existing buyer guide and exact approved affiliate URL.

content_backlog.scope: Clear business fit and reasons not to choose each product, exact current billing limits from official sources, relevant title/snippet and approved exact destinations.
content_backlog.basis: GSC 90-day page 70 impressions/0 clicks; query omnisend vs privy 58 impressions/0 clicks, average position 19.2. Not a 30-day or proven conversion result.

content_backlog.scope: Evidence-backed workflow and plan-choice guidance using approved assets; avoid claiming unperformed hands-on tests. Use verified trial/code terms and preserve exact affiliate destinations.
content_backlog.basis: GA 30-day page 8 views/4 active users/1 affiliate click; two Pictory clicks including the existing trials/deals hub.

content_backlog.scope: Concrete form-use and plan-limit decision aid, with official supported facts and the provider-issued destination. No collection of user data for the worksheet.
content_backlog.basis: GA 30-day page 8 views/7 active users/1 affiliate click; GSC 90-day jotform pricing query 34 impressions.

content_backlog.scope: A distinct practical decision worksheet or comparison from the first four topics; choose using current evidence. Merge into an existing page if intent overlaps.
A second distinct decision asset; a copy-only rewrite or the same CSV does not count.
Evidence-backed expansion of a responsive topic; no unsupported new product category or mass-generated SEO pages.
Final distinct useful buyer asset, with live proof before counting as published.

content_quality_gate: A concrete buyer decision benefit beyond a plan/audit or generic rewrite
Current official or direct sources, independently verified exact destinations and clear affiliate disclosure
No fabricated hands-on experience, testimonials, savings, customer results or numeric scores
Rights verified for any partner screenshots/footage; video reuse permission is not blanket website embedding permission
Producer regeneration preserves content; existing build and registry validation gates pass
Actual deployment ancestry and expected live content/mobile usability verified with QA traffic excluded
One substantive asset counted once even if repeated on several pages or adapted into several posts

decision_rules.rule: Rank evidenced buyer interest and paid/affiliate outcomes, not output volume. Check source/period/QA quality before choosing a topic. Assign the next two concrete assets and next six conditional distribution posts.

decision_rules.when: At least 20 verified attributed sessions for a topic or channel
decision_rules.rule: Use response only as a directional allocation signal, not a statistically proven winner; a missing page-by-source dataset is not estimated from marginal totals.

decision_rules.when: At least 50 eligible page sessions and zero affiliate clicks in a matched observation window
decision_rules.rule: Check intent, offer fit and destination; make one supported narrow content/CTA change outside protected experiments and annotate it. Do not infer the cause from zero clicks alone.
Prioritize useful distribution and visibility. Record insufficient data; do not declare a product or channel successful or failed.
Verify attribution, amount/currency and commission state. Continue narrowly; one customer does not validate scaling or establish repeatable profit.

decision_rules.when: No new paid purchase at closeout
decision_rules.rule: Report failure to meet the paid goal. If fewer than 50 real affiliate clicks were obtained, distribution remains unvalidated; if 50+ clicks but no paid purchase, examine offer/intent/measurement before any further scale or spending.

initial_report.trigger: First normal hourly Watchdog run after campaign end

final_report.trigger: First normal Watchdog run after refreshed data is ready, no later than seven days after end; explicitly retain unresolved data

report_requirements: Live content and public posts with URLs and dates
Missing distribution and other unmet targets
Paid purchases, pending/approved commissions and actual cash receipts separately
Actual new and known existing costs; net profit only if supportable
Source delays, QA and exact/daily boundary limitations
closeout.duplicate_prevention: Record report delivery evidence only after a confirmed send, and reuse the existing report states. Schedule configuration alone is not delivery.
